{{Quote|No further payment until Ambassador Dolor is ''dead''... until ''I'' am promoted to replace him&mdash;as I ''deserve'' to be&mdash;with his assassination blamed on the ''Separatists''!|Lorn, to a disguised [[Jyl Somtay]]|<ref name="Jedi Masquerade">{{TCWComicCite|6.28|Jedi Masquerade}}</ref>}}
'''Lorn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] for [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yong Dolor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he [[Assassination attempt on Yong Dolor|attempted]] to replace Dolor by hiring the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Dolor and blame the murder on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], but [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jyl Somtay]] uncovered his scheme and arrested him.
